method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Bank Stocks Mired in Correction as Yields Surge Before Earnings
Equities.reason: Macro/regime signal: bank-sector weakness driven by a surge in yields ahead of earnings is a broad market risk narrative (financials sensitivity to rates, earnings risk). High relevance because banking health and rates materially affect market liquidity and cycle views.

Equities.title: Stock Losses Deepen on AI Trade, Treasuries Rally: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad-market wrap highlighting an AI-led unwind and risk-off positioning. Reflects a dominant narrative of AI trade volatility and rotation into safe-haven bonds (market-wide negative impulse for equities).

Equities.title: Korean Chip Stocks Sink on Chinese Rival Worry, Broadcom Remarks
Equities.reason: Sector/regime driver: semiconductor weakness (Korea) tied to Chinese competition and industry commentary from Broadcom is a concentrated but high-impact hit to global tech/AI supply chain and risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Chip stocks slide in wake of ‘casino’ comment by Broadcom boss
Equities.summary: Declines for Samsung and SK Hynix drag Kospi sharply lower as investors fret over scale of AI investment
Equities.reason: Reinforces tech/AI narrative: influential industry remarks increasing investor caution on scale and sustainability of AI capex, worsening sentiment in chip names and related indices.

Equities.title: Nvidia and AMD shares fall as new AI announcements fail to re-energize investors
Equities.reason: Large-cap tech-specific negative: AI announcements from leaders not translating into buying signals weakens the leadership pillar of the rally and pressures market breadth.

Equities.title: Oil rally pressures S&P, Nasdaq; Microsoft, Salesforce buoy Dow
Equities.reason: Commodity-driven cross-impact: a rising oil price is a headwind for growth/tech multiples and boosts cyclical/energy names—net negative for the market breadth and risk appetite.

Equities.title: Asian stock markets plunge, KOSPI faces bloodbath amid chip competition from China
Equities.summary: Asian stock markets face a significant sell-off in Tuesday’s session, tracking weakness in United States (US) technology stocks seen on the Columbus Day.
Equities.reason: Regional amplification: falls in Asian markets (especially KOSPI) tied to global tech weakness and competitive pressures from China reinforce the risk-off regional spillover dynamic.

Equities.title: BlackRock Turns Bullish on Short-Term Bonds, Downgrades Stocks
Equities.reason: Flow/regime indicator: a major asset manager reallocating into short-term bonds and downgrading equities signals a shift in institutional positioning and liquidity that is negative for risk assets.

Equities.title: S&P 500 futures are mixed ahead of bank earnings; South Korea's Kospi falls below 6,000
Equities.reason: Near-term market setup: mixed futures ahead of bank earnings with Korean weakness highlights earnings-led caution and cross-market contagion; relevant but lower impact than broader regime stories.

Equities.title: Dow finishes on nearly 200-point gain, but Nasdaq pulls back as tech struggles
Equities.reason: Market internals nuance: shows leadership bifurcation (Dow strength vs. Nasdaq weakness). Useful to capture divergence but lower relevance to the dominant negative regime narrative.

Rates.title: BoE’s Greene: Warns of second-round inflation effects if we act late
Rates.summary: The comments from Bank of England (BoE) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) member Megan Greene released during the Asian trade on Tuesday signals that she is worried about second-round inflation effects coming into play if we [central bank] fail to act soon.
Rates.reason: BoE MPC member flagging second‑round inflation risk increases the risk of tighter UK policy and higher yields — negative for bond prices. Material regional policy signal but not a policy decision, hence medium relevance.

Rates.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
Rates.summary: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.
Rates.reason: Direct, high‑profile warning that bond yields could spike is a clear negative for bond prices and elevates systemic rate‑risk; large relevance as it reinforces a market‑wide higher‑for‑longer narrative.

Rates.title: Higher rates could be needed to avoid 'inflationary mindset' taking hold, says Fed's Hammack
Rates.summary: The Cleveland Fed president said that tighter monetary policy would be needed to bring down inflation.
Rates.reason: A Fed regional president explicitly signalling more tightening supports expectations of higher US yields / longer‑for‑longer policy — negative for bond prices with meaningful relevance to Treasury market pricing.

Rates.title: Investors brave US Treasury rout to lock in highest yields in decades
Rates.summary: Government bond funds are attracting record inflows as borrowing costs hit their highest level in decades
Rates.reason: Reports of a Treasury 'rout' and very high borrowing costs underline the dominant narrative of rising yields; inflows are notable but occur amid a higher‑yield regime — net negative for prices.

Rates.title: US yield surge triggers mortgage hedging, adds to bond market pressure
Rates.reason: Technical and flow‑related selling (mortgage hedging) amplifying the US yield surge is a direct market-pressure transmission, increasing downside for bond prices — medium‑high relevance.

Rates.title: Treasuries Gain on Haven Demand as Trading Resumes After Holiday
Rates.reason: Short‑term safe‑haven buying pushed Treasuries higher (yields lower) as trade resumed — a near‑term positive for bond prices but limited relevance versus the larger rising‑yield backdrop.

Rates.title: Wall Street Strategists See Value in Duration After Bond Rout
Rates.reason: Strategists turning constructive on duration suggests tactical demand for bonds after the selloff — supportive for bond prices in the near term, but lower relevance vs. macro drivers keeping yields elevated.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes provide direct insight into Fed policy leanings; given prevailing market moves toward tighter expectations, the minutes are treated as modestly hawkish/negative for bond prices with material relevance.

Rates.title: Top economies heading for biggest budget deficits since Covid, IMF warns
Rates.summary: At its annual meeting, the fund calls for ‘urgent’ action to rebuild public finances
Rates.reason: Wider fiscal deterioration implies higher future issuance and upward pressure on yields — a structural negative for bond prices with moderate relevance to rate markets.

Rates.title: RBA Raised Key Rate to Counter Upside Price Risk, Remains Alert
Rates.reason: An active central bank rate hike (RBA) is a direct driver of higher local yields and supports the broader global narrative of tighter policy — negative for bond prices, but geographically specific so medium‑low relevance.

FX.title: Euro gathers strength above 1.1150 despite France’s fiscal concerns
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair gains ground to near 1.1165 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. Nonetheless, the potential upside for the major pair might be limited amid growing fiscal and political instability in France. All eyes will be on the key US inflatio
FX.reason: EUR/USD inching higher signals modest euro strength vs the dollar in Asian trade. Headline flags French fiscal/political risk which limits upside, so assign moderate positive direction and mid relevance in the USD-centric FX context.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index eases from 18-month peak; slips below 102.50
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, drifts lower during the Asians session on Tuesday, eroding a part of the previous day's strong gains to a fresh high since April 2025.
FX.reason: DXY retreat from an 18-month high is a broad USD-centric market signal that supports non-USD currency recoveries and influences cross-asset flows. High relevance as it reflects the dominant USD move.

FX.title: Swiss Franc strengthens as US Dollar Index pulls back from 18-month highs
FX.summary: USD/CHF declines after registering modest gains the previous day, trading around 0.8330 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The currency pair depreciated as the US Dollar (USD) pulled back from an 18-month high.
FX.reason: Explicit link to DXY pullback and CHF appreciation vs USD. Represents a clear FX transmission from USD weakness to a safe-haven currency — moderate relevance.

FX.title: British Pound gains on BRC Like-For-Like Retail Sales data despite geopolitical tensions
FX.summary: GBP/USD inches higher after posting modest losses in the previous day, trading around 1.3220 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair appreciated as the British Pound (GBP) gained ground following the release of British Retail Consortium (BRC) Like-For-Like Ret
FX.reason: Domestic UK retail data supporting GBP/USD moves is a direct FX-native driver. Positive for GBP vs USD but more of a regional data-driven move, hence moderate relevance.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains as BI Governor Destry reaffirms rate autonomy
FX.summary: USD/IDR depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 17,950 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) gained support against the US Dollar (USD) following comments from Bank Indonesia’s (BI) new chief, Destry
FX.reason: Central-bank signalling (BI governor reaffirming rate autonomy) is an explicit FX driver. IDR strength versus USD contributes to the broader narrative of EM currency resilience as USD eases.

FX.title: Indian Rupee gains further on RBI’s fresh measures to lower US Dollar’s demand
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends the Monday’s advance against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, driven by the announcement of fresh Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) US Dollar-related measures to shore up the domestic currency.
FX.reason: RBI action explicitly aimed at reducing USD demand is a high-impact FX transmission for INR and indicates policy-supported EM currency appreciation amid a softer DXY — higher relevance.

FX.title: Euro: Gradual downside toward key support against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight ongoing Euro (EUR) weakness against the US Dollar (USD), with EUR/USD at fresh 17‑month lows. Intraday, further losses are possible but seen contained within 1.1145–1.1185.
FX.reason: Bank note expecting EUR downside vs USD is a counter-signal to broader USD-softening headlines. Lower relevance since it is a single-bank view and conflicts with the dominant DXY pullback theme.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Bulls fail to break the 200-day SMA around 158.50
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) edges lower against the Japanese Yen (JPY) on Tuesday, although it maintains its broader bullish trend intact, favoured by a risk-averse market.
FX.reason: USD softening vs JPY in the short term supports JPY strength (relevant for major-pair flows). Technical focus limits relevance modestly, but it still reinforces the broader USD pullback narrative.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Declining 20-day EMA builds case for more downside
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is marginally higher at around 0.6960 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Technical-piece suggesting AUD/USD downside is FX-native but centered on short-term technicals; assign limited relevance and a modest negative direction for AUD vs USD.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $60.00 amid higher oil prices, US Dollar
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around $60.00 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Tuesday. Silver is struggling as rising oil prices fuel inflation concerns, bolstering expectations of further Federal Reserve
Commodities.reason: Metal-specific price-forecast piece: silver weakening driven by higher oil-driven inflation and tighter Fed expectations -> bearish for silver; technical/price-focus limits relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold remains capped near $4,200 as Fed hike bets and Iran risks limit USD corrective slide
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on its move higher and remains capped below the $4,200 round figure heading into Tuesday’s European session. The US Dollar (USD) retreats from its highest level since April 2025 amid some profit-taking, offering support t
Commodities.reason: Gold narrative capped by Fed-hike expectations / USD dynamics — mildly bearish to neutral for gold; article is price/range-focused so relevance limited.

Commodities.title: Oil: Market focuses on Persian Gulf risks – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil prices remain supported as traders focus on Middle East and Persian Gulf supply risks rather than the Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire. Brent has pushed back toward $107/bbl, while hurricane-related
Commodities.reason: Clear supply-risk focus on Persian Gulf/Middle East supporting oil prices; strong macro supply narrative with material price impact -> high relevance, bullish.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Advance as Expanding Middle East War Threatens Supply
Commodities.reason: Major newswire highlights expanding Middle East conflict threatening supply — an important, market-moving bullish driver for crude with broad implications for commodity prices.

Commodities.title: Supertankers Turn From Gulf Oil Transfer Hub Amid Iran’s Attacks
Commodities.reason: Operational disruption in tanker flows from Gulf transfer hub raises tangible supply-chain constraints — strong bullish signal for oil prices and market risk premia.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Near-term Gulf production shut-ins from hurricane risk a direct supply-side support for US crude and refined products; regionally relevant but more transitory than geopolitical shocks.

Commodities.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: EIA data showing higher crude and margins reinforces the broader oil-tightness narrative from Middle East conflict — supportive but largely descriptive of recent trend.

Commodities.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
Commodities.reason: Structural/market-structure story: tokenization expanding beyond gold to oil/lending could modestly improve liquidity and access for these commodity markets -> small positive, niche relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil prices fall as traders assess Russian diesel supply prospects and Saudi-Houthi conflict
Commodities.summary: Oil prices fell as investors assess potential supply disruptions against prospects of more Russian diesel entering global markets.
Commodities.reason: Countervailing flow: prospects of increased Russian diesel supply and other offsets are weighing on near-term prices — meaningful short-term impact but lower relevance against prevailing Middle East supply-risk narrative.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin pulls back from $84,000 as oil recovers, ETFs bleed over $600 million
Crypto.reason: Large ETF outflows (~$600M) and a pullback in BTC price point to net selling/liquidity drain — material near-term negative for crypto risk sentiment and price action.

Crypto.title: U.S. inflation, Ethereum upgrade talks: Crypto Week Ahead
Crypto.reason: Preview piece where macro (US inflation) is the dominant cross-asset risk driver (USD/real rates pressure = negative for crypto); Ethereum upgrade talk is relevant but lower-impact near-term.

Crypto.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
Crypto.reason: Rebuilt BTC/ETH liquidity reduces tail risk for the two largest assets — constructive for core crypto market structure, though altcoins remain vulnerable.

Crypto.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
Crypto.reason: Cross-asset shock (chip rout) triggered large crypto liquidations — highlights leverage and tokenized-equity contagion risk, modestly negative for market stability.

Crypto.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
Crypto.reason: Shutdown of a major NFT marketplace signals deterioration in NFT demand/volumes and is a negative for Ethereum ecosystem sentiment and related token flows.

Crypto.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
Crypto.reason: Bullish institutional/adoption narrative (large wealth transfer thesis and incremental ETH buy) supports demand story for crypto — positive but opinion-driven.

Crypto.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
Crypto.reason: Major bank expanding custody and collateral plumbing for crypto-linked stablecoin in Dubai — constructive for institutional infrastructure and adoption flows.

Crypto.title: Ledger claims CryptoBilis cases are limited as up to $93 million is traced, $10 million frozen
Crypto.reason: Security incident with meaningful funds involved; tracing/freeze limits damage but the event still weighs on custody/trust — modestly negative for sentiment.

Crypto.title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
Crypto.reason: Hardware-wallet compromise (unauthorized implant) is a serious security shock that meaningfully increases custody risk aversion — material negative for crypto user confidence.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin falls below $83,000 as dollar strength keeps markets on edge
Crypto.reason: BTC price weakness tied to USD strength/global macro caution — direct negative transmission to crypto prices and flows; elevated relevance given macro linkage.

Crypto.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
Crypto.reason: Regulatory push to prepare for stablecoin crises signals tighter cross-border oversight and potential constraints — higher relevance due to systemic/stablecoin focus.

Crypto.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Integration of BTC into traditional bank lending is a clear institutional adoption signal — positive for demand and mainstream use-cases.

Crypto.title: Altcoins rally on thin trading as bitcoin holds below $83,500
Crypto.reason: Short-lived altcoin strength on thin volumes: positive for speculative flows but low-quality and vulnerable — limited relevance to broad crypto regime.
